items.q: he and Ed Cuffee and all were both with the McKinney's Cotton Pickers

ctx.x: Well, Prince is from Norfolk, Virginia and he and Ed Cuffee and all were both with the McKinney's Cotton Pickers and of course, he died here in New York, you know. He moved here to New York after joining McKinney's Cotton Pickers. He came on here to New York. He worked around here in New York. But he -- I guess after Hawk gained such a big reputation, you know, after "Stampede," everybody was scared to even pick up a horn around Hawk.
